prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input1 is a rear-view attempt of our robot: single rear nozzle near BOTTOM, navy display far TOP, exactly2folded arms. Input2 is the approved actual E-side model/proportions authority. Correct ONLY the rear view's CAMERA ELEVATION and excessive length: it looks too top-down and its rear nozzle too long. Re-render the SAME approved robot in genuine N heading, front UP/away, rear nozzle DOWN/near, at LOW elevated orthographic camera26.565 degrees ABOVE the horizontal, not an overhead view. Broad squat silhouette. At the same physical scale, the whole N robot should have projected width:height about1.4:1, matching the approved front-view/elevated2:1 style; the nozzle is COMPACT, original model proportions, not an elongated engine. We should see a shallower roof depth and more of the original rear gunmetal vertical face. Whole body roughly560px wide and380px tall on a1024square canvas. Do not flatten/stretch the bitmap: genuinely re-render the3D camera at the requested lower elevation, with upper-left SCREEN light unchanged.
Preserve physical identity of approved input2: closed broad pentagonal ivory-ceramic/gunmetal hull, burnt-orange joints, exactly2articulated arms folded with closed2jawwrists, ONE compact central rear nozzle nearest BOTTOM, passive short front coupling hidden at far TOP, original small flat dark-navy roof display toward FRONT/TOP and integral closed lower chassis boss. No extra engines, wrists, boom, work/cargo/solarwing/antenna. No glow/exhaust/service lights/work. Both arms remain resting, same hardware count and positions. Do not swap a nozzle onto the front of an unrotated E body.
ONE complete isolated genuine N rear view, centered with generous true-transparent alpha=0 margins, no frame/magenta/background/ground/castshadow/checkerboard/text/label/watermark. Crisp isometric original game machinery for unchanged64x48 native cell/anchor(-32,-32). Keep the whole broad shallow rear-facing body comfortably visible and all parts uncut.

layout_review.camera: One rear nozzle near/down, roof display/front far/up; folded near/far arms remain closed. Broad low rear silhouette fits the frozen native geometry at one uniform physical scale.
